articles.abstract_en: We develop a theory of low-frequency movements in inflation expectations, and use it to interpret joint dynamics of inflation and inflation expectations for the United States and other countries over the postwar period. In our theory, long-run inflation expectations are endogenous. They are driven by short-run inflation surprises, in a way that depends on recent forecasting performance and monetary policy. This distinguishes our theory from common explanations of low-frequency properties of inflation. The model, estimated using only inflation and short-term forecasts from professional surveys, accurately predicts observed measures of long-term inflation expectations and identifies episodes of unanchored expectations. (JEL D83, D84, E12, E23, E31, E37, E52)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一个关于通胀预期低频变动的理论，并用它来解释战后时期美国及其他国家通胀与通胀预期的联合动态。在我们的理论中，长期通胀预期是内生的。它们由短期通胀意外驱动，其方式取决于近期的预测表现和货币政策。这使我们的理论区别于关于通胀低频特性的常见解释。该模型仅使用来自专业调查的通胀和短期预测进行估计，能准确预测观测到的长期通胀预期指标，并识别出预期未锚定的时期。（JEL D83, D84, E12, E23, E31, E37, E52）

articles.title_en: Firm Entry and Exit and Aggregate Growth
articles.title_cn: 企业进入与退出及总体增长
articles.abstract_en: Applying the Foster, Haltiwanger, and Krizan (2001) decomposition to plant-level manufacturing data from Chile and Korea, we find that the entry and exit of plants account for a larger fraction of aggregate productivity growth during periods of fast GDP growth. To analyze this relationship, we develop a model of firm entry and exit based on Hopenhayn (1992). When we introduce reforms that reduce entry costs or reduce barriers to technology adoption into a calibrated model, we find that the entry and exit terms in the FHK decomposition become more important as GDP grows rapidly, just as they do in the data from Chile and Korea. (JEL D24, E23, L13, L60, O14, O32, O47)
articles.abstract_cn: 将Foster、Haltiwanger和Krizan（2001）的分解方法应用于智利和韩国的工厂层面制造业数据，我们发现，在GDP快速增长时期，工厂的进入和退出对总体生产率增长的贡献份额更大。为分析这一关系，我们基于Hopenhayn（1992）构建了一个企业进入与退出模型。当我们在校准模型中引入降低进入成本或减少技术采用障碍的改革时，我们发现FHK分解中的进入和退出项在GDP快速增长时变得更加重要，这与智利和韩国的数据表现一致。（JEL D24, E23, L13, L60, O14, O32, O47）

articles.abstract_en: The European debt crisis presents a challenge to our understanding of the relationship between government bond yields and economic fundamentals. I argue that information frictions are an important missing element and support that claim with evidence on the evolution of GDP forecast errors after 2008. I build a quantitative model of sovereign default where output features rare disasters and agents learn about their realizations. Debt crises coincide with economic depressions and develop gradually while markets update their expectations about future income. Calibrated to the Portuguese economy, the model replicates the comovement of bond spreads and output before and after 2008. (JEL E23, E27, E32, E43, F34, H63)
articles.abstract_cn: 欧洲债务危机对我们理解政府债券收益率与经济基本面之间的关系提出了挑战。我认为信息摩擦是一个重要的缺失要素，并通过2008年后GDP预测误差的演变证据支持这一主张。我构建了一个主权违约的定量模型，其中产出具有罕见灾难特征，且代理人学习其实现情况。债务危机与经济萧条同时发生，并在市场更新对未来收入预期时逐渐发展。以葡萄牙经济为校准对象，该模型复制了2008年前后债券利差与产出的共同变动。(JEL E23, E27, E32, E43, F34, H63)

articles.title_en: Uncovering the Effects of the Zero Lower Bound with an Endogenous Financial Wedge
articles.title_cn: 内生金融楔子下零利率下限效应的揭示
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of the zero lower bound (ZLB) on the severity of financial crises using an incomplete markets New Keynesian model with two occasionally binding constraints: a ZLB on the nominal interest rate and a borrowing constraint tied to an asset price. The model’s financial wedge corresponds to an endogenous multiplier on the borrowing constraint. Binding ZLB exacerbates financial crises through its interaction with the asset fire sale vicious cycle, driving up the financial wedge. Our results offer a novel reinterpretation of the negligible effect of the ZLB in representative agent New Keynesian models with exogenous wedges. (JEL E12, E31, E32, E43, E52, G01)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个具有两个偶发约束的不完全市场新凯恩斯模型来研究零利率下限（ZLB）对金融危机严重程度的影响：名义利率的零下限和与资产价格相关的借款约束。模型的金融楔子对应于借款约束上的内生乘数。约束性的零利率下限通过与资产甩卖恶性循环的相互作用加剧金融危机，推高金融楔子。我们的结果为具有外生楔子的代表性主体新凯恩斯模型中零利率下限的微不足道效应提供了一种新的重新解释。（JEL E12, E31, E32, E43, E52, G01）

articles.title_en: Robust Predictions for DSGE Models with Incomplete Information
articles.title_cn: 不完全信息DSGE模型的稳健预测
articles.abstract_en: We provide predictions for DSGE models with incomplete information that are robust across information structures. Our approach maps an incomplete-information model into a full-information economy with time-varying expectation wedges and provides conditions that ensure the wedges are rationalizable by some information structure. Using our approach, we quantify the potential importance of information as a source of business cycle fluctuations in an otherwise frictionless model. Our approach uncovers a central role for firm-specific demand shocks in supporting aggregate confidence fluctuations. Only if firms face unobserved local demand shocks can confidence fluctuations account for a significant portion of the US business cycle. (JEL D82, D83, E13, E31, E32)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为具有不完全信息的DSGE模型提供预测，这些预测在信息结构上具有稳健性。我们的方法将不完全信息模型转化为具有时变预期楔子的完全信息经济，并提供确保这些楔子可由某种信息结构合理化的条件。利用我们的方法，我们量化了信息作为商业周期波动来源在无摩擦模型中的潜在重要性。我们的方法揭示了企业特定需求冲击在支持总体信心波动中的核心作用。只有当企业面临未观察到的局部需求冲击时，信心波动才能解释美国商业周期的显著部分。(JEL D82, D83, E13, E31, E32)

articles.title_en: The Government Spending Multiplier in a Multisector Economy
articles.title_cn: 多部门经济中的政府支出乘数
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of aggregate government spending shocks in a production network economy where sectors differ in their price rigidity, factor intensities, use of intermediate inputs, and contribution to final demand. The model implies an aggregate value-added multiplier that is 75 percent (and $0.32) larger than that obtained in the average one-sector economy. This amplification is mainly driven by input–output linkages and—to a lesser extent—sectoral heterogeneity in price rigidity. Aggregate government spending shocks also lead to heterogeneous responses of sectoral value added, which are larger among upstream industries. We present novel empirical evidence supporting this prediction. (JEL E12, E16, E23, E43, E52, E62, H50)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了生产网络经济中总政府支出冲击的影响，在该经济中，各部门在价格刚性、要素密集度、中间投入使用以及对最终需求的贡献方面存在差异。该模型隐含的总增加值乘数比平均单部门经济中获得的乘数大75%（以及0.32美元）。这种放大效应主要由投入产出联系驱动，其次是价格刚性的部门异质性。总政府支出冲击还导致部门增加值的异质性反应，其中上游行业的反应更大。我们提供了支持这一预测的新颖经验证据。（JEL E12, E16, E23, E43, E52, E62, H50）

articles.title_en: Skilled Labor Productivity and Cross-Country Income Differences
articles.title_cn: 技能劳动力生产率与跨国收入差异
articles.abstract_en: This paper revisits the question of how allowing for imperfect substitution among workers with different skill levels affects the results of development accounting. We consider a range of models that nest the approaches in the literature and calibrate them to a common set of moments, including particularly evidence on the wage gains of migrants. We obtain two main results. First, human capital accounts for between one-half and three-fourths of cross-country income gaps. Second, human capital accounts for only modest variation in the relative productivity of skilled versus unskilled labor. (JEL E24, E25, J22, J23, J24, J31, J61)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文重新探讨了允许不同技能水平工人之间不完全替代如何影响发展核算结果的问题。我们考虑了一系列涵盖文献中各种方法的模型，并将它们校准到一组共同的矩条件，特别是包括移民工资收益的证据。我们得到两个主要结果。第一，人力资本解释了跨国收入差距的二分之一到四分之三。第二，人力资本仅解释了技能与非技能劳动力相对生产率的适度变化。（JEL E24, E25, J22, J23, J24, J31, J61）

articles.title_en: Women, Wealth Effects, and Slow Recoveries
articles.title_cn: 女性、财富效应与缓慢复苏
articles.abstract_en: Business cycle recoveries have slowed in recent decades. This slowdown comes entirely from female employment, as women’s employment rates converged toward men’s during the past half-century. But does the slowdown in the growth of female employment rates translate into a slowdown for overall employment rates? We estimate the extent to which women “crowd out” men in the labor market across US states, and find that it is small. Through the lens of a general equilibrium model with home production, we show this statistic implies that 60-75 percent of the slowdown in recent business cycle recoveries can be explained by female convergence.(JEL D13, E24, E32, J16, J21)
articles.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，商业周期复苏有所放缓。这种放缓完全来自女性就业，因为过去半个世纪中，女性就业率向男性趋同。但女性就业率增长的放缓是否转化为整体就业率的放缓？我们估算了美国各州劳动力市场中女性“挤出”男性的程度，发现这一程度很小。通过一个包含家庭生产的一般均衡模型的视角，我们表明这一统计量意味着，近期商业周期复苏放缓的60-75%可以由女性趋同来解释。(JEL D13, E24, E32, J16, J21)

articles.title_en: Consumption Heterogeneity: Micro Drivers and Macro Implications
articles.title_cn: 消费异质性：微观驱动因素与宏观影响
articles.abstract_en: We document heterogeneity in the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) across household characteristics relevant to understanding heterogeneous agent models and monetary policy transmission. We find a strong negative relationship between household liquid wealth and MPC. We show that household liquid wealth predicts MPC closely for every other household characteristic we look at. We use a new empirical method that overcomes sources of bias found in the existing literature, along with administrative data from Denmark that allow us to identify heterogeneous behavior. We use our results to analyze monetary policy transmission mechanisms in both Denmark and the United States. (JEL D12, D31, E21, E43, E52, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了不同家庭特征下边际消费倾向（MPC）的异质性，这些特征对于理解异质性代理人模型和货币政策传导至关重要。我们发现家庭流动性财富与MPC之间存在强烈的负相关关系。我们表明，对于我们所考察的每一个其他家庭特征，家庭流动性财富都能紧密预测MPC。我们采用了一种新的实证方法，克服了现有文献中存在的偏差来源，并结合丹麦的行政数据，使我们能够识别异质性行为。我们利用我们的结果来分析丹麦和美国的货币政策传导机制。（JEL D12, D31, E21, E43, E52, G51）

articles.abstract_en: E-commerce represents a rapidly growing share of consumer spending in the United States. We use transactions-level data on credit and debit cards from Visa, Inc. between 2007 and 2017 to quantify the resulting consumer surplus. We estimate e-commerce reached 8 percent of consumption by 2017, yielding the equivalent of a 1 percent boost to their consumption, or over $1,000 per household per year. While some of the gains arose from avoiding travel costs to local merchants, most of the gains stemmed from substituting to merchants available online but not locally. Higher income consumers gained more, as did consumers in more densely populated counties. (JEL D12, E21, G51, L81, L86)
articles.abstract_cn: 电子商务在美国消费者支出中所占份额迅速增长。我们使用Visa公司2007年至2017年间的信用卡和借记卡交易级数据来量化由此产生的消费者剩余。我们估计，到2017年，电子商务占消费的比例达到8%，相当于消费增长1%，即每户每年超过1,000美元。虽然部分收益来自避免前往当地商户的旅行成本，但大部分收益源于转向在线可得而本地没有的商户。高收入消费者获益更多，人口密度更高的县的消费者也是如此。（JEL D12, E21, G51, L81, L86）

articles.title_en: Fiscal Policy, Relative Prices, and Net Exports in a Currency Union
articles.title_cn: 货币联盟中的财政政策、相对价格与净出口
articles.abstract_en: The hoped-for silver lining of euro-area austerity programs was to raise external competitiveness and improve current accounts. Using product- and industry-level data for 12 countries over the period 1999–2018, we show that reductions in government spending reduce prices and wages but only for products with low import content and industries with low export shares. This leads to asymmetric expenditure switching, with net exports improving through lower imports rather than higher exports. The standard small-open-economy model fails to rationalize these findings, but home bias in government spending and frictions preventing factor prices from equalizing across sectors considerably improve the fit of the model. (JEL E31, E62, F14, F33, F45, H20, H50)
articles.abstract_cn: 欧元区紧缩计划的希望之光在于提高外部竞争力并改善经常账户。利用1999-2018年期间12个国家的产品和行业层面数据，我们表明政府支出的减少会降低价格和工资，但仅限于进口含量低的产品和出口份额低的行业。这导致了不对称的支出转换，净出口通过降低进口而非增加出口来改善。标准的小型开放经济模型无法合理化解这些发现，但政府支出的国内偏好以及阻止要素价格在行业间均等化的摩擦显著提高了模型的拟合度。(JEL E31, E62, F14, F33, F45, H20, H50)

articles.title_en: House Prices and Consumption: A New Instrumental Variables Approach
articles.title_cn: 房价与消费：一种新的工具变量方法
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a novel Bartik-like instrument for house prices consisting of the local composition of housing characteristics interacted with aggregate changes in the marginal prices of these characteristics. Using household-level panel data, we estimate elasticities of nondurable consumption expenditures with respect to house prices of around 0.1. These consumption effects are concentrated among the young and those most likely to be facing tight borrowing constraints. A decomposition shows that identifying variation in the instrument is associated with times and locations where house prices have varied the most: during the housing bust of the mid-2000s and in the western United States. (JEL D12, E21, G51, R21, R31)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖的类似巴蒂克的房价工具变量，该工具由住房特征的本地构成与这些特征边际价格的总体变化相互作用而成。利用家庭层面面板数据，我们估计非耐用消费支出对房价的弹性约为0.1。这些消费效应集中在年轻人和最可能面临严格借贷约束的人群中。分解表明，工具中的识别变异与房价波动最大的时期和地点相关：在2000年代中期住房市场崩盘期间以及美国西部。(JEL D12, E21, G51, R21, R31)

articles.title_en: A Risky Venture: Income Dynamics among Pass-Through Business Owners
articles.title_cn: 风险事业：穿透型企业主的收入动态
articles.abstract_en: We employ a large panel of US income tax returns for the period 1987–2018 to extensively characterize and quantify business income risk. Our findings show business income to be much riskier than labor income. Business income is less persistent and is characterized by higher tail risk. Furthermore, when compared to labor income, heterogeneity across households is less important in explaining the cross-sectional variation in business income, and within-household income variation is more important. Our results underscore the income risks business owners face and provide stylized facts and parameter estimates useful for quantitative macroeconomic models and policy analysis. (JEL D31, G51, H24, J23, J31, K34, L26)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用1987-2018年间美国个人所得税申报表的大型面板数据，广泛刻画并量化了企业收入风险。我们的研究结果表明，企业收入的风险远高于劳动收入。企业收入的持续性较弱，且具有较高的尾部风险。此外，与劳动收入相比，家庭间异质性在解释企业收入的横截面差异方面重要性较低，而家庭内收入变动的重要性则更高。我们的结果强调了企业主面临的收入风险，并为定量宏观经济模型和政策分析提供了典型化事实和参数估计。(JEL D31, G51, H24, J23, J31, K34, L26)

articles.title_en: Childcare Subsidies and Child Skill Accumulation in One- and Two-Parent Families
articles.title_cn: 儿童保育补贴与单亲及双亲家庭儿童技能积累
articles.abstract_en: I examine the role of family structure and childcare subsidies in child skill accumulation. I establish empirically that skill accumulation is more responsive to childcare price for one-parent families than for two-parent families. I analyze the effects of childcare subsidies in a model featuring endogenous family formation, parental altruism, and a baseline subsidy resembling that of the United States. I find that eliminating this subsidy generates welfare losses of 1.63 percent of lifetime consumption, that equilibrium adjustments act to mitigate these losses, and that increasing uptake among one-parent families yields the highest welfare gains per additional recipient. (JEL I21, I26, J12, J13, J24)
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了家庭结构和儿童保育补贴在儿童技能积累中的作用。我通过实证发现，对于单亲家庭而言，技能积累对保育价格的响应程度高于双亲家庭。我在一个包含内生家庭形成、父母利他主义以及类似美国基线补贴的模型中分析了儿童保育补贴的影响。我发现，取消该补贴将造成相当于终身消费1.63%的福利损失，均衡调整会减轻这些损失，并且提高单亲家庭的补贴领取率能带来每位新增受助者最高的福利收益。(JEL I21, I26, J12, J13, J24)

articles.title_en: Firm Wages in a Frictional Labor Market
articles.title_cn: 摩擦性劳动力市场中的企业工资
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies wage setting in a directed search model of multiworker firms facing within-firm equity constraints on wages. The constraints reduce wages, as firms exploit their monopsony power over their existing workers, rendering wages less responsive to productivity in doing so. They also give rise to a time inconsistency in the dynamic firm problem, as firms face a less elastic labor supply in the short run than in the long run, making commitment to future wages valuable. Constrained firms find it profitable to fix wages, and doing so is good for worker welfare and resource allocation in equilibrium. (JEL E24, E32, J31, J42, J63, J64, M52)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了多工人企业在面临企业内部工资公平约束时的定向搜索模型中的工资设定。这些约束降低了工资，因为企业利用其对现有工人的垄断权力，从而使工资对生产率的反应减弱。它们还导致动态企业问题中的时间不一致性，因为企业在短期内面临的劳动力供给弹性小于长期，这使得对未来工资的承诺变得有价值。受约束的企业发现固定工资是有利可图的，这样做在均衡中对工人福利和资源配置是有益的。（JEL E24, E32, J31, J42, J63, J64, M52）
